$note: Local development's Trusted Verifiers List, loaded by scripts/seed-tvl.ts when SCVS_TRUSTED_VERIFIERS_SOURCE names nothing else. Every URL here is a service's default dev port, and all three are verification-svc's: url (cdn_root until 2026-09-03 — a public contract must not assume a CDN) and manifest_url are its static result root, and bulk_load_url is its own bulk-load route (services/verification-svc/src/modules/bulk-load/own-bulk-load.controller.ts) on port 5000 — suffix-less since later (TRD §5.7 reserves .json for documents a static origin serves as-is); the .json spelling still answers as a deprecated alias until 2026-12-01 — NOT query-svc's 5001, which served that path until it was removed. Nothing cross-checks this file against the routes the services register, and a wrong port fails open rather than loudly: discovery 404s, one `verifier sync incomplete` warn is logged, and GET /api/query/v1/wasms then answers 200 with an empty page, which a consumer records as synchronised.
